CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN WRAP RING OF THREE MOLTEN GOLD STRANDS: three smooth, slightly irregular, high-polish gold strands, like poured liquid gold, sweep side by side across the top of the finger and fan apart. The outer strand is the thickest, about 2.5mm, swelling into a rounded droplet at its end; the middle strand is slimmer, about 1.5mm; the third, fine strand bends around ONE OVAL clear faceted stone held in four slim gold claws, so the oval sits at the front of the ring beside the strands, its long axis along the strands. The strands look hand-poured, with soft ripples, never machined. Exactly one stone: one clear oval, never round, never pear; no pave, no halo, no other stones anywhere; the strands are smooth polished gold, never twisted rope, never textured; exactly three strands, never two, never four.

SCALE TEST: The oval stone is about 6x8mm, smaller than a fingernail; the strands are 1.5 to 2.5mm wide; at its widest the ring covers about 15mm. The piece keeps its true small size against the cube, never enlarged.

GROUND: The cream plaster cube fills the lower half of the frame, large and close; flat faces, softly rounded corners, fine plaster grain. Warm cream seamless behind with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no fingers, no model, no fabric, no props, no flowers, no box. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.
